profile.headline: Software Engineer @Google
profile.summary: Software Engineer @Google. Northeastern CS Grad. Experienced in end-to-end development, REST APIs, databases, and pipeline management.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Mountain View, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
• Led the effort to migrate a backend API call system in order to deprecate a legacy service for the Google Assistant, improving code maintainability and reducing technical debt
• Developed a detailed design document outlining the migration strategy, including step-by-step procedures, timeline, and potential challenges, ensuring a structured and efficient implementation
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and dependencies, resulting in an error-free migration with zero impact to users and zero downtime
positions.insights: Skills: Programming · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Computer Science · Software Design · C++

positions.title: SDE Intern
positions.locationName: North Reading, Massachusetts, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
• Implemented architectural enhancements to use more accurate robotic coordination, reducing technical debt and providing more stable and consistent data to consumers
• Leveraged Java to write and debug code for more than 80 microservices in a large-scale distributed system aimed at streamlining package movement in fulfillment centers, empowering a fleet of over 200,000 autonomous robots
• Monitored and maintained over 30 deployment pipelines, promptly identifying and addressing any blockages to increase developer velocity
positions.insights: Skills: Programming · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Computer Science

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Built and tested over 20 REST API endpoints to supplement a new trading system, decreasing latency by 80%
• Performed over 100 code reviews as part of SCRUM process collaboratively with 6 other developers
• Developed an interface and built out endpoints allowing users to automatically generate blockchain addresses, reducing time to generate by 70%
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · React.js · Python (Programming Language) · Programming · Blockchain · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Computer Science · Github · REST APIs · Php · Git · Microsoft Visual Studio Code · Back-End Web Development · Front-End Development · MySQL · Scrum · Databases · SQL

positions.title: Software Engineer, Project Manager
positions.description:
• Communicated directly with CEO of startup to transcribe vision into over 20 tangible user stories for developers
• Coordinated weekly meetings with a team of 7 to ensure user stories were on track and code was reviewed
• Spearheaded development and launch of algorithmic based software in under 3 months, placing 3rd on ProductHunt and beating over 60 other companies, many being VC funded
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · React.js · Programming · Project Management · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Computer Science · Github · REST APIs · Git · Microsoft Visual Studio Code · Front-End Development · Scrum · Databases

positions.title: Application and Software Development Intern
positions.description:
• Standardized 15 existing hierarchical tables for consistent sorting throughout application
• Implemented hierarchy selection functionality for product numbers, vastly minimizing time to search
• Practiced regular code reviews collaboratively in CI/CD process to ensure quality code is produced in a timely manner
• Implemented hierarchy selection functionality for product numbers, vastly improving user experience
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · React.js · Python (Programming Language) · Programming · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Computer Science · Github · REST APIs · Git · Back-End Web Development · Front-End Development · Scrum · Databases · SQL

positions.title: Owner, Designer, Developer
positions.description:
• Singlehandedly designed, developed, and published mobile game to Google Play Store
• Implemented in-app purchases through Unity IAP as well as online leaderboard through Google Play Games SDK
• Integrated Firebase tracking for user statistics of over 230 users
